entries.source: E. H. von Ried, Zur ältesten Geschichte des tirolischen Geschlechtes von Greifenstein, II, Veröffentlichungen des Tiroler Landesmuseums Ferdinandeum 3/50 (1906 or journal volume date as catalogued); Numbered extract 18: charter of 24 July 1239; printed witness list
entries.english: At the parish church of St Mary in Bolzano, a formal proceeding assembled prominent local men as witnesses. The witness list includes lords F., H. and B., described explicitly as brothers de Rosenbach. F. and H. may be identified with Friedrich and Heinrich in nearby records, while the identity represented by B. is uncertain.

facts.subject: the brothers F., H., and B. de Rosenbach
facts.content: were named among the witnesses at the proceeding.

entries.latin: dnorum. F. et H. et B. fratrum de Rosenbach
